# InsureTech Development Guidelines

Auto-generated from all feature plans. Last updated: 2026-03-12

## Active Technologies

- **Go 1.24+** — Gateway, AuthN (:50053), AuthZ (:50054), B2B (:50055), KYC, Partner, Fraud, Payment, Notification, Workflow, DocGen, Storage
- **C# .NET 8 (PoliSync)** — Insurance domain: Product, Quote, Order, Policy, Claims
- **TypeScript / Next.js 16** — 5 web portals (system, insurer, partners, business, regulatory)
- **Swift 5.9+ / Kotlin (Jetpack Compose)** — Customer App (iOS+Android), Agent App (Android)
- **Protocol Buffers 3 + Buf CLI v2** — All service contracts; `buf lint` + `buf breaking` required
- **GORM v2** — Proto-gen `.pb.go` models only (inject_gorm_tags.go pipeline)
- **PostgreSQL 17** — Schemas: authn_schema, authz_schema, b2b_schema, insurance_schema
- **Apache Kafka** — Domain events; topic format: `insuretech.<domain>.v<N>.<EventName>`
- **Redis 7+** — Sessions, JTI blocklist, Casbin permission cache, JWKS cache (5 min TTL)
- **Casbin v2** — PERM model: `(sub=user:<uuid>, dom=portal:tenant_id, obj=svc:service/resource, act, eft)`
- **OpenTelemetry Go SDK** — Traces + Prometheus RED metrics on all gRPC handlers

## Project Layout

```text
proto/insuretech/              ← Source of truth for all contracts
  authn/, authz/, b2b/, ...
gen/go/, gen/ts/, gen/csharp/  ← DO NOT EDIT — generated by scripts/generate.ps1
api/openapi.yaml               ← DO NOT EDIT — generated by api/generator/main.py
backend/inscore/microservices/ ← Go microservices
  authn/, authz/, b2b/, ...
backend/inscore/db/
  migrations/                  ← ALTER TABLE only; no CREATE TABLE or DML
  seeds/                       ← INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING only
scripts/generate.ps1           ← Full proto → gen → openapi → sdk pipeline
run_migration.ps1              ← DB migration runner
```

## Commands

```powershell
# Generate everything (proto → gen → openapi → sdk)
.\scripts\generate.ps1

# Validate proto changes
buf lint
buf breaking --against '.git#branch=main'

# Apply DB migrations
.\run_migration.ps1 --Target=primary

# Apply seeds only
.\run_migration.ps1 --Target=primary --seeds-only

# Run unit tests (all services)
go test ./backend/inscore/microservices/authn/... -short
go test ./backend/inscore/microservices/authz/... -short
go test ./backend/inscore/microservices/b2b/...   -short

# Run integration tests (requires Docker)
go test ./backend/inscore/microservices/b2b/... -run Integration -count=1 -timeout 120s
```

## Code Style & Conventions

- **Proto-first**: commit `.proto` before any service code; no service code without a proto contract
- **GORM models**: ONLY proto-gen `.pb.go` files with injected GORM tags — no hand-crafted structs
- **Error handling**: gRPC status codes (not `errors.New`); use `codes.InvalidArgument`, `codes.NotFound`, `codes.FailedPrecondition`
- **Event publishing**: always via `EventPublisher` interface; nil producer must no-op + log (never panic)
- **Tenant scoping**: every DB query filters by `business_id` or `tenant_id`; never return cross-tenant data
- **Status transitions**: guard with `UPDATE … WHERE status = <prev_status> AND id = ?`; check `RowsAffected > 0`
- **Casbin subject format**: `"user:<uuid>"`; domain: `"portal:tenant_id"`; object: `"svc:service/resource"`
- **Kafka topic format**: `insuretech.<domain>.v<N>.<EventName>` (e.g. `insuretech.b2b.v1.PurchaseOrderApproved`)
- **HTTP path conventions**: plural nouns; action verbs use `:verb` suffix on resource ID (`/purchase-orders/{id}:approve`)

## Constitution Reference

See `.specify/memory/constitution.md` v1.1.0 for all 12 governing principles.

Critical non-negotiables:
- **Principle I**: Proto commit must precede service code
- **Principle V**: Argon2id passwords; AES-256-GCM PII encryption; zero-trust
- **Principle XI**: SQL migrations = ALTER/INDEX only; CREATE TABLE and DML are FORBIDDEN in `db/migrations/`
